integrity: A self-contained probabilistic proof and independent exact finite-state checker are included. Numerical tests are corroboration, not proof for all sizes. Historical uniqueness is not certified.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive integer r, balanced base classes n,n, identical rates, no desorption; unexamined growing-r limit; 1989 original full text unavailable for priority resolution.
title: Folded-binomial jamming law for a fixed impurity class in tripartite dimer adsorption
